# freshdesk_agents (Data Source)

Every agent on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_agents" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) Every agent the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `agents`.

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the agent has activated their account.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether the agent is accepting omniroute assignments.
- `contribution_group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of groups the agent may only view.
- `created_at` (String) When the agent was created (RFC 3339).
- `email` (String) Email address of the agent.
- `focus_mode` (Boolean) Whether focus mode is enabled.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the groups the agent belongs to.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the agent.
- `job_title` (String) Job title of the agent.
- `language` (String) Language code of the agent.
- `last_login_at` (String) When the agent last signed in (RFC 3339).
- `mobile` (String) Mobile number of the agent.
- `name` (String) Display name of the agent.
- `occasional` (Boolean) Whether the agent is occasional rather than full-time.
- `phone` (String) Phone number of the agent.
- `role_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the roles granted to the agent.
- `signature` (String) Email signature of the agent, in HTML.
- `skill_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the skills assigned to the agent.
- `ticket_scope` (Number) Ticket permission: 1 global, 2 group, 3 restricted.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone of the agent.
- `type` (String) Agent type in string form.
- `updated_at` (String) When the agent was last changed (RFC 3339).
